all_or_none.description: Flag to indicate if the order should be executed as an All or None order.

annotation.description: Optional annotation for the execution order.

client_execution_order_id.description: Idempotency key for the execution order request.

limit_price.description: Limit price of the execution order request. If omitted, the order will inherit the limit price of the order, if exists.

skip_lob_quotes.description: Flag to indicate whether to skip matching LOB quotes and only use RFQ quotes.

trader_id.description: an option to supply with a new trader ID

min_wait_time.description: Minimum wait time for the execution order.

min_number_quotes.description: Minimum number of quotes required on the side of the order, before execution can proceed. If the protocol is `request_for_quote`, this is the minimum number of RFQ quotes required. If the protocol is `limit_order_book`, this is the minimum number of LOB quotes required.

max_transaction_cost_dollar.description: Maximum transaction cost in dollars. Max buy price = estimated price * par value + maxDollar, Min sell price = estimated price * par value - maxDollar. Ex. a value of `5` would mean the transaction cost must be within $5 of the instrument's estimated price in dollars, meaning when buying a bond with a estimated price of $100 and a par value of $1000, the transaction cost must be below $1005.

max_transaction_cost_percent.description: Maximum transaction cost in percent. Max buy price = estimated price * (1 + maxPct / 100), Min sell price = estimated price * (1 - maxPct / 100). Ex. a value of `5` would mean the transaction cost must be within 5% of the instrument's estimated price in percent, meaning when buying a bond with a estimated price of $100, the transaction cost must be below $105.

max_transaction_cost_yield.description: Maximum transaction cost in yield. Max buy yield = estimated ytw - maxYTW, Max sell yield = estimated ytw + maxYTW. Ex. a value of `0.5` would mean the transaction cost must be within 50 bps of the instrument's estimated yield, meaning when buying a bond with an estimated yield to worst of 1.5%, the transaction cost must be above 1.0%.

Fee.title: Fee
Fee.description: The fee to apply to the order.

recipient_id.description: Unique ID of the recipient of the fee.

fee_amount.description: Fee amount to apply to the order.

max_fee_amount.description: Maximum fee amount to apply to the order.

fee_name.description: Optional name for the fee, for easier identification.

FeeAmountType.title: Fee Amount Type
FeeAmountType.description:
The method used to calculate the fee amount. Supported types include:

- `percentage_of_par`: Fee as a percentage of par value.
  Example: `0.10` = 10 basis points of par value.

- `percentage_of_market_value`: Fee as a percentage of the quote price (market value).
  Example: `1` = 1% of market value.

- `yield_bps`: Fee expressed in yield terms, in basis points.
  Example: `100` = 100 basis points of yield.

- `percentage_of_concession`: Fee applies to concession based quoting mechanism, especially for new issue CDs.
  Example: `50` = 50 percent of all concession from the dealer.

FeeType.title: Fee Type
FeeType.description: The type of fee to apply to the order. Valid values are "markup", "commission", and "sales_credit".

OrderSize.title: Amount
OrderSize.description:
The Amount of an order with a specified `type` indicating how the amount is represented.
- **Par:** Represents the order size in face value (e.g., a corporate bond with a $1,000 face value).
- **Notional:** Represents the order size in notional dollar value.
- **Shares:** Represents the order size in number of shares (for equities).

PrincipalAccountID.description: Moment account ID of the principal account (book) the execution order is booked to.

disclosure.description: The disclosure for the RFQ. Currently, only `disclosed` is supported.

due_after.description: Specifies how duration following RFQ creation, after which the RFQ becomes due.

subject_after.description: Specifies the duration following the due time (or submission time if no due time is defined) during which quotes are considered subject.

expire_after.description: Specifies the duration following the latest of due time, subject time, or submission time, after which the RFQ expires.

RecipientType.title: Recipient Type
RecipientType.description: The type of recipient for the fee.
